column1: #Text=Can you describe the content of this map?
#Text=Large-scale map section of Procé Park in Nantes.
#Text=The park is located in the center of the map, surrounded by Boulevard des Anglais, Boulevard Clovis Constant, Boulevard Albert Thomas, and Rue des Dervallières to the south.
#Text=A river called the Chézine flows from south to northwest, widening after passing Procé Park.
#Text=Inside the park, there are streets and paths represented by a single brown line and pedestrian paths represented by dotted lines.
#Text=Surrounding the park is an urban area with streets (some of which are named), roundabouts (on the boulevards), and buildings.
#Text=Two areas of buildings are colored purple to indicate two school complexes (to the east and northeast of the park).
